```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(GimmeMyOmics)
library(GimmmeMySC)
library(GimmeMyPlot)
library(magrittr)
library(rlist)
library(Seurat)
library(cowplot)
library(kableExtra)

path <- file.path(
  dirname(getwd()),
  "inst",
  "extdata"
)
path_fig <- file.path(dirname(getwd()), "vignettes", "figures", "differential_expression")

fc_threshold  <- log2(1.5)
p_threshold <- .05
pct_threshold <- 0.25
exp_threshold <- 0.1

load(file.path(path, "wt_bcell_cycle.rda"))
```

## Differentially Expressed Genes
```{r}
# ids <- data.frame(
#     id.1 = c(6, 3, 3, 3, 0, 0, 4, 5, 5),
#     id.2 = c(2, 2, 6, 0, 1, 4, 1, 1, 4)
# )

ids <- data.frame(
    id.1 = c(0),
    id.2 = c(2)
)

cluster_marker_genes <- dea_sc(seurat, ids)
```

```{r}
l_dea_raw <- cluster_marker_genes %>%
  mutate(gene_name = gene) %>%
  format_dea(fc_threshold = fc_threshold, p_threshold = p_threshold)
```

## Volcano plots
```{r}
l_dea_proc <- dea2deseq(l_dea_raw)

kable_dea(l_dea_proc, file = file.path(path_fig, "table_dea.png"))

l_deg_top <- list.map(
  l_dea_proc,
  f(x) ~ top_genes(
    x,
    fc_threshold = fc_threshold,
    p_threshold = p_threshold,
    n = 15
  )
)

p <- volcano_sc(
  l_dea_proc,
  top_genes = l_deg_top,
  fc_threshold = fc_threshold,
  p_threshold = p_threshold
  )

plot_grid(plotlist = p, align = "hv", ncol = 4, nrow = 2)
```


```{r}
gene_lists <- list.map(l_deg_top, pull(., "gene_name") %>% sort())
custom_upset_barplot(gene_lists, ratio = 1)
```

## Enrichment
```{r, eval = FALSE}
if (species == "human") {
  org_lib <- "org.Hs.eg.db"
} else {
    org_lib <- "org.Mm.eg.db"
}
library(org_lib, character.only = TRUE)
filter <- dplyr::filter
select <- dplyr::select
rename <- dplyr::rename
```

### ORA
```{r, eval = FALSE}
l_ora <- list.map(
  l_dea,
  f(x) ~enrichGO(
    gene = pull(x, "gene_name"),
    OrgDb = get(org_lib),
    keyType = "ALIAS",
    ont = "ALL",
    pvalueCutoff = 1,
    qvalueCutoff = 1,
    universe = Features(seurat)
  )
)
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
list.map(
    l_ora ,
    f(x, y, z) ~ {
      plot_enrich(
        x,
        cex = 0.65,
        label_x = "generatio",
        method = "ora",
        # regex = pathway_keywords()$immunity_additional,
        n = 15,
        title = z,
        name_id = "GeneRatio"
      )
    }
) %>% 
  compact() %>%
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 2, nrow = 2, align = "hv")

list.map(l_ora, f(i) ~print_enrich(i, method = method) %>% nrow()) %>%
    list.cbind() %>%
    set_rownames("# Pathway GO") %>%
    kable0()

list.map(
  l_ora,
  f(i, j, k) ~ {
    tmp <- print_enrich(
      i, 
      regex = pathway_keywords()$immunity_additional
    )
    if (nrow(tmp) > 1)
  heatmap_enrich_full(
    l_ora[[j]],
    l_dea[[j]],
    regex = pathway_keywords()$immunity_additional,
    width_text = 100
  ) + labs( title = paste("Cluster", k), y = NULL, x = NULL) +
     theme_custom()
  }
) %>%
  compact() %>%
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 2, nrow = NULL, align = "hv")
 

omics2excel(
  l_ora, 
  file = file.path(path, "ora.xlsx"), 
  func = function(x) print_enrich(x, method = "ora")
)
```

### GSEA
```{r, eval = FALSE}
var <- "gene_name"

l_deg_ranked <- list.map(
    l_dea_proc,
    f(x) ~ {
        metric <- "log2FoldChange"
        de_genes_ranked <- top_genes(x, 0.01, 1, n = Inf) %>% #, rank = TRUE) %>%
            # mutate(ranked_padj = sign(log2FoldChange) * (log10(padj))) %>%
            pull(metric, name = var) %>%
            sort(decreasing = TRUE) %>%
            .[!is.na(names(.))] %>%
            .[is.finite(.)] %>%
            .[!duplicated(.)]
    }
)

l_gsea <- list.map(
    l_deg_ranked,
    f(x) ~ {
        gseGO(
            x,
            ont = "ALL",
            OrgDb = get(org_lib),
            keyType = "ALIAS",
            verbose = FALSE
        ) %>%
            # setReadable(org_lib, 'ENSEMBL') %>%
            suppressWarnings() %>%
            invisible()
    }
)
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
list.map(
    l_gsea,
    f(x, y, z) ~ {
      plot_enrich(
        x,
        cex = 0.65,
        label_x = "NES",
        method = "gsea",
        # regex = pathway_keywords()$immunity_additional,
        n = 15,
        title = z
      )
    }
) %>%
  compact() %>%
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 2, nrow = 2, align = "hv")

list.map(l_gsea, f(i) ~print_enrich(i, method = "gsea") %>% nrow()) %>%
    list.cbind() %>%
    set_rownames("# Pathway GO") %>%
    kable0()

omics2excel(
  l_gsea, 
  file = file.path(path, "gsea.xlsx"), 
  func = function(x) print_enrich(x, method = "gsea")
)
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
list.map(
    l_gsea,
    f(i, j, k) ~ {
        tmp <- print_enrich(
            i,
            method = "gsea",
            regex = pathway_keywords()$immunity_additional
        )
        if (nrow(tmp) > 1)
            heatmap_enrich_full(
                l_gsea[[j]],
                l_dea[[j]],
                method = "gsea",
                regex = pathway_keywords()$immunity_additional,
                width_text = 100
            ) + labs( title = paste("Cluster", k), y = NULL, x = NULL) +
            theme_custom()
    }
)  %>%
    compact() %>%
    plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 2, nrow = NULL, align = "hv")
```

## Dotplots
```{r}
l_dea <- format_dea_sc(
  l_dea_raw,
  pct_threshold, 
  fc_threshold = fc_threshold,
  p_threshold = p_threshold
)
```

```{r}
n_tops <- c(10, 15, 50)
tops <- list.map(
  n_tops,
    f(i) ~
    list.map(
    l_dea, 
    f(x) ~ x %>%
      # filter(log2FoldChange > 0) %>%
    slice_head(n = i)
  ) 
) %>% set_names(n_tops)
top10 <- tops[["10"]] %>%
    list.rbind()
```


```{r, eval = FALSE}
last_row_numbers <- top10 %>%
    # ungroup() %>%
    filter(!duplicated(gene)) %>%
    mutate(row_num = row_number() %>% rev()) %>%
    # mutate(row_num = row_number()) %>% # if pseudo
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
    pull(row_num) %>%
    sort()

DoHeatmap(
    seurat,
    features = top10$gene,
    # group.by = "cell_type_na",
    group.colors = palette_discrete(),
    slot = "data"
) + 
    NoLegend() + 
    scale_fill_gradientn(
        colors = brewer.pal(11, "Spectral"),
        na.value = "black"
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = last_row_numbers[-1] - 0.5, color = "black", linetype = "solid", linewidth = 1)
```

```{r, fig.height = 3.7, fig.width = 8}
last_row_numbers <- top10 %>%
    # ungroup() %>%
    filter(!duplicated(gene)) %>%
    mutate(row_num = row_number()) %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
    pull(row_num) %>%
    sort()

plot_dot(
    seurat, 
    features = unique(pull(top10, "gene"))
) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = last_row_numbers + 0.5)

cluster_marker_genes %>% 
    filter(cluster == first(cluster)) %>%
  head(15) %>%
  mutate(padj = format(padj, digits = 1, scientific = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(FC = 2^abs(log2FoldChange) * sign(log2FoldChange)) %>%
   set_rownames(pull(., gene)) %>%
  select(FC, padj) %>%
  kable0()
```

```{r}
top50 <- tops[["50"]] %>%
  list.rbind()
p <- top50 %>%
  pull(cluster) %>%
  unique() %>%
  list.map(
  f(x) ~ plot_dot(
    seurat,
    features = filter(top50, cluster == x) %>% pull("gene") %>% unique()
  ) +
    labs(title = x)
)
p
```

```{r}
p2 <- plot_mfeature(
    seurat,
    tops[["15"]],
    func = function(x) pull(x, gene_name) %>% head(12)
)
p2

p3 <- plot_mviolin(
    seurat,
    tops[["15"]],
    func = function(x) pull(x, gene_name) %>% head(12)
)
p3
```
